The text contains both objective and subjective elements. The statement "Many scientists agree that climate change is exacerbated by human activity" is an objective fact, as it reports on the consensus within the scientific community, which can be verified through data and surveys. The phrase "there are still some dissenting voices within the scientific community" is also an objective fact, as it acknowledges the existence of minority opinions, which is a verifiable reality. However, the use of the word "exacerbated" carries a slight evaluative tone, implying a worsening of conditions, which can be seen as a value judgment, though in scientific contexts, it is often treated as a factual description of increased intensity. Overall, the text is primarily objective because it describes the state of scientific opinion rather than expressing a personal belief or emotion.
